formal_pre_post.rule: Protect the exact whole word(s) being scored or explicitly contrasted in each assessment item, plus the exact structured-response pair where that pair is itself the assessed construct. Do not block ordinary incidental context words merely because they appear in a prompt.
formal_pre_post.buildRule: Add explicit protectedTargetWords metadata to each pre/post item (or generate a central assessment-target registry), then reject ordinary excerpt-bank entries that contain those protected target words as instructional/application targets. Also reject copied or near-copied assessment prompts, response frames, and distractor sets.
formal_pre_post.note: The taught morpheme itself is not protected. Instruction is expected to teach the morpheme; protection preserves the scored whole-word evidence.

migration_challenge.purpose: Independent end-of-Flight transfer on the Migration Map
migration_challenge.rule: All 30 words remain unseen in Learn, ordinary practice, connected-text instruction/application, and future teacher-generated materials before the challenge.

connected_text_transfer.purpose: Future short protected Check Transfer excerpts/items
connected_text_transfer.rule: Create a separate reserved bank. Its whole words must not overlap formal pre/post or Migration Challenge and must be excluded from all ordinary instruction/application once reserved.
